useCases.title: Review queue ordered by ETA
mainFlow: Officers work from a Booking Board that lists Submitted and Under Review requests ordered by ETA.

useCases.title: Open a request for review
mainFlow: Opening a request for review moves it to Under Review and records the reviewing officer.

useCases.title: Manual review only — no automatic approval (see OQ-1 in F001)
mainFlow: There is no automatic approval; every booking request is reviewed by a berth officer before it can become Approved.
useCases.notes: Directly contradicts 08-booking-lifecycle.md#L62 (fast-track auto-approval). This use case is the governing one per the ASSUMED position recorded in F001 OQ-1.

useCases.title: Record an approval decision with an outcome
mainFlow: An approval decision has one of three outcomes: Approved, Rejected or Returned for Information.

useCases.title: Rejection requires a reason
mainFlow: When Outcome is Rejected, a reason is required before the decision can be submitted.
useCases.notes: Screenshot-only rule (validation error 'REJECTION REASON IS REQUIRED WHEN OUTCOME IS REJECTED'), not stated in any page's prose — read via vision.

useCases.title: Return for Information — one resubmission
mainFlow: A request Returned for Information goes back to the agent, who may amend and resubmit it once.

useCases.title: Harbour Master override
mainFlow: Only the Harbour Master may override a Rejected decision, and the override is recorded with a reason.

useCases.title: Review screen highlights berth-limit exceedance
mainFlow: The review screen shows the vessel's dimensions next to the berth's limits and highlights any exceedance in red.

useCases.title: Review screen shows the vessel's last five bookings (workshop-only, not in any chapter)
mainFlow: The review screen must show the last five bookings of the same vessel.
useCases.notes: Raised only in workshop-notes.md Session 3, never promoted into 21-officer-review-screen.html. See openQuestions OQ-5.

domainEntities.name: ApprovalDecision
domainEntities.notes: Reason is documented Optional in the data dictionary table, but the officer-review-screen validation screenshot shows it becomes REQUIRED when Outcome = Rejected — the dictionary table states the column's nullability, not this conditional rule.

openQuestions.question: Officer review screen must show the vessel's last five bookings (workshop-notes.md Session 3) — build it?
openQuestions.assumption: Build it: a small, well-specified addition (list of 5 most recent BookingRequest rows for the same Vessel) explicitly requested by officers in the workshop.
